label: HYBRID SYNTHETIC
hypothesis: A fixed panel on disjoint organizer-declared empty development recordings has nonempty positive and negative reference-contour labels in every specified object group, including a measured-surface attachment.
criterion: For each split and each of low, thin_suspended, edge, long, measured_surface_attached, at least one full-form contour-intersecting and one nonintersecting scenario must be supported by real source returns. The criterion validates the panel, not detector recall or field safety.
